name: Outpatient / ambulatory surgery center
summary: Licensed ASC: operating and procedure rooms, pre-op/PACU, sterile processing, medical gases, heavy HVAC (pressurization, high air-change rates, humidity control) and emergency power. Only one public national ASC-specific benchmark was retrievable (RSMeans 2019 model); the mid is anchored by its ASC-to-MOB ratio and bounded by hospital data (Cumming, RLB, RSMeans).

typicalSize.method: Judgment: 2–8 OR freestanding ASCs; RSMeans model is 12,500 SF (e1).

primaryUnitsPerAcre.method: Derived: 1-story building ≈ 20–25% coverage with 4–5 spaces/1,000 SF parking and drop-off canopy.

parkingPerPrimaryUnit.method: Spaces per GSF (judgment; patient + escort + staff).

perPrimaryUnit.method: Ratio method: RSMeans 2019 ASC model hard cost ÷ MOB 1-story model = $427.41/$217.02 = 1.97 (union) and $399.36/$197.75 = 2.02 (open shop) (e1, e2). Apply ≈1.95 to the medical-office building-only mid ($400 − $30 sitework = $370) → ≈ $720 building, ≈ $750 with sitework; rounded to $720 because ASC sites are compact. Bounds: hospitals are the ceiling — RLB 2026 Dallas hospital $495–710, 18-city median $655–998 (e5); Cumming 2025 Dallas hospital $830–1,250 (e4). Low $520 ≈ Cumming Dallas MOB high ($690) × 0.75 ≈ RLB Dallas hospital low; High $980 ≈ RLB hospital median high. Derived — verify.

scope.notes: Contractor price incl. GC and fee; includes medical gas piping, OR HVAC, emergency power distribution and typical sitework; excludes surgical equipment, booms/lights (owner FF&E), land and soft costs.

systemSplit.method: Derived from RSMeans 2022 hospital medians (e6): mechanical 17.95% → 23 20% (ORs need high ACH/pressurization), electrical 14.1% → 26 15% + 27 3% + 28 1%, plumbing 7.65% → 22 8% (incl. med gas). Sitework 6% (compact site). Architectural remainder split by judgment.

lineItems.name: Medical gas & vacuum per OR

cost.method: From _blocks/specialty-mep.json medical-gas (derived there). Qty = 1 OR per ≈4,000 GSF (judgment: 4-OR, 15,000–16,000 SF center).

lineItems.notes: Inside baseline; shown as a carve-out.

cost.method: From _blocks/specialty-mep.json emergency-generator; 300 kW default for a ≈15,000-SF ASC (judgment).

lineItems.name: OR equipment package (surgical lights, booms, tables, integration)

cost.method: Derived judgment (no public source fetched): lights + booms ≈ $150k–300k, table ≈ $50k–100k, integration/video ≈ $50k–300k per OR.

lineItems.notes: Owner equipment; counted here rather than in ffe to keep it per-OR.

cost.method: Derived judgment: 2 steam sterilizers + low-temp sterilizer + washer-disinfector + case carts.

perPrimaryUnit.method: Derived judgment: pre-op/PACU stretchers, monitors, nurse stations, waiting and staff furniture (OR and sterile processing equipment carried as line items).

pctOfHard.method: Derived. A/E 9% (RSMeans ASC model fee, e7) + medical equipment planning 1% + state licensure/CON and AHCA-type reviews 1–3% + commissioning 1% + permits 1–2% + insurance/legal 2–3% + developer fee 3–5% + PM 2%. | Second pass (2026-10-24, main session): Reduced 4 points to remove the developer fee (3–5%) the original build-up included. The engine adds impact & tap fees, the developer fee and construction financing as their own lines (docs/BUDGET_ENGINE.md §5), so this bucket must exclude them.

softCosts.notes: Certificate-of-need states add application fees and legal costs; Medicare certification/accreditation surveys are pre-opening costs.

design.method: Healthcare design contingency norm (program and code review changes).

perPrimaryUnit.method: Min ≈ RSMeans 2019 ASC model ($399 open shop) escalated + sitework + 20% soft; max ≈ Cumming hospital Dallas high ($1,250, e4) × 1.27 soft — an ASC should not exceed hospital all-in cost.
